incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: redis.accept_queue depth HIGH in us-east-1 on redis-main-01. metric: accept_queue=372 (p90=451). PagerDuty incident INC-2026-REDIS fired. Dash: https://telemetry.redwood/redis/acceptqueue

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: INC-2026-REDIS triggered. Escalation: SRE oncall -> paging sequence started. Link to incident: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026-REDIS

Alice K: Ack — I'm taking primary. Looking at logs and client counts.

Ben M: I can see a spike in pgbouncer errors and a ton of `ERR maxclients` on redis-main-01. Confirming 502s at gateway for embeddings-route.

Ben M (logs): ```
[redis-main-01] 2026-03-15T15:42:21.123Z # Warning: accept: Too many clients
[redis-main-01] 2026-03-15T15:42:21.124Z # Error: ERR Client ID 12345: connection rejected - maxclients
```

Carla S: Any recent deploys or a traffic ramp? Product says a bulk-embeddings job was toggled on around 15:30. Could be correlated.

Alice K: Confirmed — feature flag `bulk-embeddings` was enabled at 15:29. Rolling the flag back now.

Dmitri R: Quick notes:
- accept_queue indicates accept socket backlog is growing, likely because backend can't accept new connections (maxclients).
- Scaling replicas helps headroom for clients; config change to maxclients requires rolling restart for redis pods.
- Also consider shedding non-critical traffic at the ingress layer (rate limit or feature-flag) to relieve pressure immediately.

Alice K: Running mitigation steps from playbook:
1) Disable `bulk-embeddings` flag (done).
2) Apply ingress throttling to embeddings route (rate-limit burst=100, rps=20).
3) Scale redis statefulset from 3 -> 5 replicas to buy headroom. Command: `kubectl scale statefulset redis-main --replicas=5 -n prod`
4) Increase redis maxclients env for container and trigger rolling restart (will do next if scaling doesn't drop queue).

Eva C: Pushing the ingress rate-limit now. Patch applied. Traffic to embeddings route dropped ~70% in the last 90s.

Ben M: After rate-limiting + flag rollback: accept_queue dropping from 372 -> 48 in ~2 minutes. pgbouncer 502s falling back to baseline.

Alice K: K8s scale command succeeded, new pods scheduled. Waiting for redis-main-04/05 to be ready.

Dmitri R: If queue doesn't stabilize once new replicas are up, we'll bump maxclients to 20k and roll. Plan: change env REDIS_MAXCLIENTS -> 20000 and do rolling restart via pod template update. Aim to avoid full downtime.

Carla S: Customer impact: embeddings endpoints in us-east-1 saw ~12% 5xx for last 10m. Notifying CS for any inbound alerts. Enterprise customer "Acme Corp" called earlier — passing details to Account team.

Alice K: Temporary mitigation summary: feature flag rollback + ingress throttling + scale to 5 replicas. Accept_queue now stabilizing at ~30. Continuing to monitor. ETA for full recovery if replicas healthy: 10–12 min.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: INC-2026-REDIS acknowledged by Alice K at 15:44 UTC. Auto-escalation paused.

Ben M: Post-scale metrics look good. I'll keep an eye on pgbouncer pools and client churn.

Dmitri R: Recommend follow-ups once stable:
- Permanently add a conservative per-route throttling rule for heavy embedding calls.
- Add an alert on average connections per-second crossing threshold (earlier than accept_queue).
- Revisit default maxclients and connection pooling for pgbouncer->redis.

Alice K: Handing off monitoring to Ben M for the next 30 minutes. If things stay green, we'll resolve incident and file a short postmortem with timeline + customer impact.

Ben M: Ack — on watch. If accept_queue climbs again, I will escalate and perform maxclients bump.

incident-bot: SYSTEM: Alert rate normalized for INC-2026-REDIS. No active pages in last 5m.

Alice K: Closing loop: will open a quick incident doc with steps taken and customer impact. Thanks all for the quick response. :heart:

Carla S: Thanks - notify CS + AE with note of mitigation and ETA for postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-REDIS status: resolved by Alice K at 15:56 UTC.

Alice K: filing follow-up ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-4987 — contains timeline, metrics, and recommended actions.
